settings.text: A 12.8V 100Ah Group 31 LiFePO4 deep-cycle battery with 1,280Wh rated energy, Bluetooth 5.0 monitoring, IP65 protection, up to 15,000 cycles at 60% DoD and an up-to-10-year life reference for RV, marine and off-grid auxiliary power systems.

settings.heading: Build a Group 31 multi-pack
settings.body: Choose 1, 2, 5 or 10 units, or use a custom quantity.

settings.image_alt: SuntNeew Group 31 battery installed in an RV auxiliary battery bay
settings.heading: A Group 31 format built around the auxiliary battery bay.
settings.body: The 339 × 185 × 218mm case helps set the layout for an RV auxiliary system. Confirm your tray, hold-down, terminal clearance and cable route before ordering; the Group 31 name does not guarantee a universal drop-in fit.

settings.image_alt: SuntNeew Group 31 battery supporting 12 volt auxiliary RV power at a campsite
settings.heading: 1,280Wh for the 12V loads that make a campsite feel settled.
settings.body: 100Ah rated capacity and a 100A continuous-discharge rating support a planned 12V auxiliary system, not engine starting. Use the runtime guide in the gallery as an estimate, then size the inverter, fusing and wiring around your actual loads.

settings.image_alt: SuntNeew Group 31 battery and phone for Bluetooth status monitoring
settings.eyebrow: 3. CHECK IT BEFORE YOU OPEN THE BAY
settings.heading: Bluetooth status visibility for everyday use.
settings.body: Use compatible Bluetooth 5.0 monitoring to review state of charge, voltage, current and battery temperature before changing loads or charging sources. Follow the product manual and app instructions for the available functions.

settings.image_alt: SuntNeew Group 31 battery in an RV solar charging setup
settings.heading: Bring shore, solar or driving charge through the right equipment.
settings.body: Plan LiFePO4-compatible CC/CV charge sources: an AC charger, solar with an MPPT controller, an alternator through a DC-to-DC charger, or a generator feeding a compatible charger. Do not connect sources directly to the battery terminals.

settings.heading: A Group 31 battery selected from the bay outward.
settings.lede: G31 starts with the physical battery bay, then focuses on practical 12V auxiliary power, status visibility and compatible charging for the way an RV is actually used.

settings.label: Product-life reference
settings.value: Up to 10 years; actual life varies by operating conditions

settings.label: BMS protection
settings.value: Low-temperature charge, overcharge, over-discharge, over-current, short-circuit and over-temperature protection

settings.label: Series / parallel expansion
settings.value: Up to 4S or 4P; up to 16 matched batteries in 4P4S

settings.label: Terminal hardware
settings.value: M8 × 12mm positive and negative terminal bolts

settings.label: Enclosure protection
settings.value: IP65 — dust-tight and protected against water jets; not for immersion

settings.label: Temperature ranges
settings.value: Charge 0–55°C; discharge -20–60°C; storage -10–50°C; charging resumes above 5°C after low-temperature protection

settings.heading: Group 31 technical specifications
settings.lede: Review the G31's electrical, environmental and service information in one place. Cycle life, product life and runtime vary with depth of discharge, load, charging, temperature and operating conditions.

settings.heading: Product and after-sales help when you need it.
settings.body: Contact SuntNeew support 24/7 for product setup, charging, Bluetooth, installation and after-sales questions. Keep the order details, model number and clear photos available to help the team handle the request efficiently.

settings.heading: Five years of product service coverage.
settings.body: The 5-Year Service period covers the product's after-sales service relationship and is separate from the Up to 10-Year Life reference. Product life describes expected service life under suitable conditions; it is not a 10-year warranty statement.

settings.image_alt: Collection of product compliance and test documents
settings.heading: Open the available model and cell documentation.
settings.body: The downloads include FCC equipment authorization and supplier declaration, IP65, EMC, RoHS and UL 1642 cell documentation. The UL 1642 file applies to the listed cell models and should not be read as a complete-battery UL certification.

settings.heading: Support, service and the documents behind the product.
settings.lede: Keep after-sales support, 5-Year Service and the available compliance files together so customers can review the promise and the supporting material in one place.

settings.question: What conditions apply to the 15,000+ cycle claim?
settings.answer: The current tiered reference is 4,000+ cycles at 100% depth of discharge, 6,000+ at 80% DoD and up to 15,000 at 60% DoD. Actual cycle life varies with charge and discharge rate, temperature, maintenance, depth of discharge and operating conditions.

settings.question: Is Up to 10-Year Life the same as 5-Year Service?
settings.answer: No. Up to 10-Year Life is a product-life reference under suitable use. 5-Year Service describes the after-sales service period. Neither phrase should be rewritten as a 10-year warranty.

settings.question: What is included in 24/7 Support?
settings.answer: You can contact SuntNeew support for product setup, charging, Bluetooth, installation and after-sales questions. Provide the order information, model number and photos or readings relevant to the issue.

settings.question: Can this battery be used to start an engine?
settings.answer: No. This is a deep-cycle auxiliary battery and is not intended to start a vehicle, boat engine or other device. Do not use it as a starting battery.

settings.question: What should I confirm before installation?
settings.answer: Confirm the 339 × 185 × 218mm enclosure, terminal position, hold-down, upright mounting, cable route and service clearance. Size conductors, fuses, disconnects, inverter and charging sources for the complete DC system.

settings.question: Are the appliance runtime figures guaranteed?
settings.answer: No. They are theoretical estimates based on 1,280Wh rated energy and the stated appliance loads. Actual runtime changes with duty cycle, inverter efficiency, battery condition, temperature and the real power draw of the connected equipment.

settings.question: Can an IP65 battery be submerged?
settings.answer: No. IP65 means the enclosure is dust-tight and protected against water jets. It is not an immersion rating; keep the battery secured, upright and protected in accordance with the product manual.
